title: Direct-mapped: miss then hit
description: How an address is split, why the first load of a line misses and its neighbour hits.

title: The index is not sequential
description: Addresses far apart can land in the same set.

title: Conflict misses
description: Two lines in one set push each other out until a second way is added.

title: Tracking LRU
description: In a full set, the *least recently used* way is the victim. Read the LRU column to name it before it happens.

title: FIFO versus LRU
description: The same five loads under *FIFO* and under *LRU*, and where they differ.

title: Spatial locality and line size
description: A loop over consecutive words, with short lines and with long lines.

title: Write-back and stale memory
description: A store under *write-back* changes only the cache. Memory stays stale until the dirty line leaves.

title: Write-through and allocate
description: Where a store goes under *write-through*, and what changes when a store miss does not allocate.

title: AMAT and measured cost
description: Hit time, miss penalty and the stall in *timed mode*: predict AMAT, then compare it with what was measured.
